title: Stand STRONG IN FAITH, God Is Still By Your Side (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: God is still by your side stand strong in faith have you ever tried to build a tower with a deck of cards maybe not but doing it takes patience care and balance each card must be perfectly aligned or the whole Tower will come tumbling down in life sometimes we can feel like we're that Tower Of Cards wobbling on the brink of collapse sometimes the Winds of challenges from every side fear and doubt blow our way threatening to knock us down but

today I bring you good news we are not left to stand alone stand strong in faith God is still by your side our foundation Is Not Fragile like a card it's as solid and steady as the love of our God he promises in Deuteronomy 31 verse 6. be strong and courageous do not be afraid or terrified because of them for the Lord your God goes with you he will never leave you nor forsake you when faced with the Gusty Winds of

Trials we need to stand firm in faith not because of Our Own Strength but because we know that God is our solid foundation he is our Rock he is our shield and hiding place the promises of God provide a solid base for us to stand strong in every situation stand strong in faith I want you to understand that Faith isn't just for when the wind howls at us and the Trials come but it is also for our everyday life our every

moment when our faith in God is deep and strong we stay firm despite the storms of life this concept Echoes the message of the Bible in Psalm 1 verse 3 where the person who trusts in God is compared to a tree planted by streams of water you can stand strong in your faith through prayer and trusting in God's unwavering presence because no matter how Fierce the wind blows no matter how unsteady the situation may seem God is still by our side

are ever steady never failing Foundation praise God now let's think again about the story of Joseph despite being sold into slavery by his own brothers and experiencing unfair trials Joseph never ceased to place his trust in God he remained unshakable he was fully confident that God was with him just as God promises Us in Joshua 1 verse 9 have I not commanded you be strong and courageous do not be afraid do not be discouraged for the Lord your God will be

with you wherever you go remember the time when Peter and John healed a man who'd been lame from birth this can be found in Acts 3 verses 1 to 10. he was a man who couldn't walk yet the moment Peter and John told him to rise in the name of Jesus he did this miracle was a testament to the faith of the man as well as the disciples teaches us that when we have faith in God's power remarkable things can happen

now let's turn to Abraham we couldn't talk about faith without mentioning faithful Abraham Abraham is known as the father of faith and he is honored for his obedience Romans 4 verse 3 tells us for what does the scripture say Abraham believed God and it was accounted to him for righteousness he received a seemingly impossible promise from God Abraham was told that he would be the father of many nations as mentioned in Genesis 17 Verses 4 to 5. as for me this

is my Covenant with you you will be the father of many nations no longer will you be called Abram your name will be Abraham for I have made you a father of many nations I will make you very fruitful I will make nations of you and Kings will come from you even when the situation looked impossible Abraham chose to trust God his response to God's promise shows us that we should hold on to our faith believing that God's words are true

and he will always stand by us so being strong in faith means to trust in God no matter the circumstances it is to believe in his incredible power to bring about miracles and to have unwavering confidence in his promises knowing that he is always with us having faith is not just for big moments like when you need help with a big problem it's also for everyday things think of it like breathing we don't just breathe when we're running or working hard

we breathe all the time even when we're sleeping or just sitting faith is like that it's something we need to use every day not just on difficult days in the book of Thessalonians in one part first Thessalonians 5 17 it says pray without stopping that means talking to God all the time not just when things are hard or when we want something or just when we're kneeling just like breathing we should pray all the time even when you sleep at nights

and turn in your bed before coming to full Consciousness you can pray by Whispering thank you Jesus for I Praise You Lord also while driving or while you journey to and fro you may whisper a prayer like Lord take full control Lord I love you or Lord I Thank you that you're always with me and I could go on and on remember prayer doesn't have to be long but it needs to be sincere through prayer you can tell God about your

day share your Joys and worries and ask for his help we are told in Philippians 4 verse 6. don't worry about anything instead pray about everything we reach out to God with prayer because we love him and want to talk with him because we know that we need him and we are safer with him in our journey of faith we should also seek to know God better and the way to do this is by reading his word the Bible it's our

guidebook faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God when we are growing in faith even in difficult times when we are scared or confused we must remember to trust God even when we don't understand what's happening we need to believe that God loves us and wants what's best for us Proverbs 3 verses five to six guides us on this saying trust in the Lord with all your heart and do not lean on your own understanding and when we

put our trust in God we should always thank God for all his blessings both for present blessings and the blessings that are yet to come the Bible tells us in first Thessalonians 5 Verse 18 to give thanks in all circumstances remember friends stepping out in faith isn't about doing big heroic things it's about doing small things every day with great love trusting God every step of the way so faith is for every day not just for big problems or Miracles and

prayer is how we hold God's hand trusting that he is always with us just like he promises in Hebrews 13 verse 5. I will never leave you or forsake you now sometimes life can be tough problems and worries may make us tired and sad but remember we're never alone in this journey like a caring friend walking beside us God is always there even when it doesn't seem that way in Psalm 34 Verse 18 the Bible tells us the Lord is close

to the Brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit so if you're feeling worn out remember that God is very very close to you ready to help every day both in small things and in big things let's trust God we can ask God for help say thanks to him and tell him our worries do not doubt this is what it means to stand strong in our faith it's like in the Book of James in the Bible where it says in

James 1 verses 6. but when you ask you must believe and not doubt having faith in God can change our lives it can make us see things differently and help us have a closer relationship with God when we really understand and believe that God is always with us Our Lives will be full of strength and courage faith is not just believing that God can it's knowing that he will remember Hebrews 11 verse 6 reminds us but without faith it is impossible

to please him for he that cometh to God must believe that he is and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him so let's live every day with this faith and remember no matter what happens stand strong in faith God is still by your side now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings

of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God dear heavenly father you are worthy of all our praises and worship Lord You Are My Strength my guide and my constant companion now and forevermore all glory honor and power Belongs To You O Lord father I come before you today with a humble and thankful heart Lord you know all things you see all things and there's nowhere I can go that you are not I take comfort in knowing that

you are with me Lord I pray that you strengthen my faith and keep me grounded and deeply rooted in your love Lord help me to stand firm trusting in your presence and your promise to never leave me nor forsake me even when faced with challenges and the storms of life help me to remember that you are the calm in the storm father I also pray for my loved ones my family my friends just as you are with me be with them

too Lord in their moments of doubt be their Assurance in their moments of fear be their courage may they also stand strong in faith knowing that they are never alone for you are always by their side in the name of Jesus I declare that my faith will not falter I declare that I will not be shaken I will not be moved I declare that my trust is in you dear God and you alone Lord I know the challenges will come trials

May seek to shake my faith but I stand firm Lord knowing that these trials are not bigger than you I rebuke any power that seeks to destabilize my faith I rebuke every spirit of fear and every Spirit of doubt in the name of Jesus father you are my refuge and my Fortress as I navigate through life guide my steps Lead Me in the path of righteousness even when I walk through the valley of the shadow of death I will fear no

evil for you are with me your rod and your staff they comfort me God I thank you for your love and your mercy thank you for always being by my side thank you for the faith to believe in you and Trust in your word as I step out each day I pray that you go before me and stand beside me cover me Lord in the name of Jesus I declare victory over my fears I declare victory over my challenges I declare

that my faith will stand strong and I declare that my trust in you is unshakable as I say this prayer together with everyone listening for every person opening their heart to you right now Lord I ask that you fill them with your Holy Spirit and with your love for anyone who needs strength to get through this day Lord may you give them strength and courage for anyone who woke up feeling hurt or pained Holy Spirit may you be their comforter Lord

may you have mercy upon them and deliver them I pray father help them to feel calm when they are feeling stressed or when their heart is worried for the person who feels lost and needs some help figuring out what to do I ask Lord that you will bring them to experience your grace and goodness Lord may you lead and direct them in a plain path father I stand strong in faith trusting in your word and your promises thank you Lord for

hearing and answering my prayer in the mighty name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your

support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comment section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory and so that other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world can join us and start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus May the grace and peace
of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you
